dropzones.name: Aerodrom Urije (Prijedor)

operators.name: Vazduhoplovni klub Skydive Banjaluka (tandem jumps at Urije, 4 Jul 2025, per a YouTube title seen in search results)

dropzones.season: Summer: annual boogie and competition week (late June to early July)

dropzones.name: Sportski aerodrom Golubić (Bihać)
dropzones.status_evidence: Aero centar Panorama has held the Para Challenge Cup at Golubić airfield every year: Sep 2022, Jul 2024, the weekend before 22 Jul 2025 (with a Cessna from Hungary), and 25-26 Jul 2026, when RTV USK called it traditional and reported tandems offered to the public. That is recurring event-based jumping.

dropzones.name: Sportski aerodrom "Kenan Jusufbašić" (Visoko)

operators.name: Slobodan Pad (visiting tandem team from Croatia)

dropzones.status_evidence: Slobodan Pad offered tandem jumps at Visoko airfield on 28-31 May 2026 (booking page), from a Cessna 182. This is a scheduled visit; no resident dropzone or regular season found. Re-checked 2026-11-14: Slobodan Pad publishes tandem jump dates of 28–31 May 2026 and explicitly locates its Sarajevo offer at Visoko airfield. The offer describes its Cessna 182; the evidence supports scheduled visiting jump days rather than year-round service.

sources.what: Operator page: tandem jumps 'Sarajevo' at Aerodrom Visoko, dates 28-31 May 2026
